Unsafe call set_flags_recursive() inside a _PyEval_StopTheWorld region in '_PyType_SetFlagsRecursive'. During STW every other thread is suspended; this call may invoke Python code, set an exception via the format machinery, or take a lock a stopped thread holds — which can deadlock the world or corrupt interpreter state on the free-threaded build. Category: transitively_invokes_python. Call _PyEval_StartTheWorld before it (cf. Python/gc_free_threading.c:2223). Intra-file analysis: transitive callees in other files are not followed.
